title: ICAB P5 - Business Strategy & Technology
summary: Strategic formulation, competitive analysis, strategic choice, methods of strategic development, technology integration, performance monitoring, and business ethics.

all.name: Full Syllabus Tracker
all.blurb: Official 2025 Syllabus chapter and topic tracker for Business Strategy & Technology. Track your study progress across all syllabus areas.

stages.title: Area 1: Strategic Formulation & Manifold Analysis
stages.name: Area 1: Strategic Formulation & Manifold Analysis
stages.description: External environmental analysis, resource-based view (VRIO), core competencies, competitor profiling.

nodes.name: Strategic Audit, Resource View & Industry Dynamics
nodes.description: Strategic direction and mission; PESTEL environmental audit; Porter's Diamond of national advantage; Resource-Based View (RBV); VRIO framework (Value, Rarity, Inimitability, Organization); Porter's Value Chain; strategic groups and benchmarking.
topics: Strategic planning process: Vision, mission, strategic intent
External macro-environmental forecasting and scenario planning
Porter's Diamond model for competitive advantage of nations (Bangladesh RMG/Pharma)
Resource-Based View: Tangible vs intangible assets, threshold vs distinctive capabilities
VRIO framework analysis to test for sustainable competitive advantage
Porter's Value Chain: Primary activities, support activities, margin optimization
Strategic group analysis and competitive rivalry mapping
learningOutcomes: Apply Porter's Diamond to analyze emerging export sectors in Bangladesh.
Deconstruct corporate operations using Value Chain analysis.
checklists: Read Strategic Audit, Resource View & Industry Dynamics in ICAB Study Manual
resources: Relevant Acts & Standards (IFRS / ISA / Tax Acts)

stages.title: Area 2: Strategic Choice & Evaluation
stages.name: Area 2: Strategic Choice & Evaluation
stages.description: Porter's generic strategies, Ansoff's matrix, evaluation criteria (SFA: Suitability, Feasibility, Acceptability).

nodes.name: Generic Strategies, Growth Vectors & SFA Evaluation
nodes.description: Porter's Generic Strategies (Cost leadership, Differentiation, Focus); Bowman's Strategy Clock; Ansoff's Growth Vector matrix; Blue Ocean Strategy; methods of development: Organic growth, Mergers & Acquisitions, Strategic alliances/Joint ventures; SFA evaluation framework (Suitability, Feasibility, Acceptability).
topics: Porter's generic competitive strategies: Cost leadership, differentiation, focus
Bowman's Strategy Clock: 8 strategic positions and hybrid strategies
Ansoff's Matrix: Market penetration, market development, product development, diversification
Blue Ocean Strategy: Value innovation, 4 Actions framework (Eliminate, Reduce, Raise, Create)
Growth pathways: Organic internal development vs M&A vs Joint ventures/alliances
Johnson, Scholes & Whittington SFA framework: Suitability, Feasibility, Acceptability
Financial acceptability metrics: Return on Capital, Cash flow impact, Shareholder Value Added
learningOutcomes: Select competitive positioning using Bowman's Strategy Clock.
Evaluate strategic options using the SFA framework.
Formulate M&A versus alliance strategies for international expansion.
checklists: Read Generic Strategies, Growth Vectors & SFA Evaluation in ICAB Study Manual
resources: Relevant Acts & Standards (IFRS / ISA / Tax Acts)

stages.title: Area 3: Implementation, Technology & Digital KPIs
stages.name: Area 3: Implementation, Technology & Digital KPIs
stages.description: Balanced Scorecard, change management, digital business models, and IT integration.

nodes.name: Balanced Scorecard, Change Management & Tech Execution
nodes.description: Strategy implementation across business units; Kaplan & Norton's Balanced Scorecard; change management models (Kotter's 8 steps, Lewin's unfreeze-change-refreeze); digital transformation and technology integration in supply chains; monitoring strategic performance.
topics: Aligning functional strategies (Marketing, Finance, Operations, HR) with corporate goals
Balanced Scorecard perspectives: Financial, Customer, Internal Business Process, Learning & Growth
Strategy maps linking non-financial leading indicators to financial lagging outcomes
Managing organizational change: Resistance causes, cultural web analysis (Johnson)
Lewin's 3-stage change model and Kotter's 8-step transformation framework
Integrating cloud, AI, and big data into enterprise operational models
learningOutcomes: Construct Balanced Scorecards with balanced financial and operational KPIs.
Design change management programs to overcome resistance.
Align technology investments with strategic enterprise objectives.
checklists: Read Balanced Scorecard, Change Management & Tech Execution in ICAB Study Manual
resources: Relevant Acts & Standards (IFRS / ISA / Tax Acts)

stages.title: Area 4: Strategic Ethics, Governance & ESG
stages.name: Area 4: Strategic Ethics, Governance & ESG
stages.description: Business ethics in strategy, stakeholder management, and corporate sustainability.

nodes.name: Strategic Ethics, Stakeholder Governance & ESG Strategy
nodes.description: Ethical considerations in strategic planning; Carroll's CSR Pyramid; stakeholder management and ethical leadership; ESG strategy alignment with UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs); data privacy and algorithmic ethics in corporate decisions.
topics: Ethical dilemmas in strategic decisions (outsourcing, factory relocations, environmental trade-offs)
Carroll's Corporate Social Responsibility Pyramid: Economic, Legal, Ethical, Philanthropic
ESG integration in corporate strategy and national SDG commitments in Bangladesh
Ethical governance of technology, artificial intelligence, and automated decision systems
Whistleblowing policies and fostering ethical corporate cultures
learningOutcomes: Evaluate strategic plans against ethical principles and ESG standards.
Apply Carroll's CSR pyramid to business decisions.
Address data ethics and privacy in algorithmic business models.
checklists: Read Strategic Ethics, Stakeholder Governance & ESG Strategy in ICAB Study Manual
resources: Relevant Acts & Standards (IFRS / ISA / Tax Acts)
